English master: AI is easiest to learn by using it.
French: L’IA s’apprend plus facilement en l’utilisant.
Swahili: Njia rahisi ya kujifunza AI ni kuitumia.
Amharic: AIን ለመማር ቀላሉ መንገድ መጠቀም ነው።
Luganda: Engeri ennyangu ey’okuyiga AI kwe kugikozesa.

English master: If you are unsure ask Copilot.
French: Si vous avez un doute demandez à Copilot.

English master: Type a short non-sensitive task list
French: Saisissez une courte liste de tâches non sensibles
Swahili: Andika orodha fupi ya kazi isiyo na taarifa nyeti
Amharic: ስሱ መረጃ የሌለበት አጭር ዝርዝር ይጻፉ
Luganda: Wandiika olukalala olumpi olutaliimu bikwata ku bantu

English master: Choose Think Deeper for a difficult task.
French: Pour une tâche complexe choisissez Think Deeper.
Swahili: Kwa kazi ngumu chagua Think Deeper.
Luganda: Ku mulimu omuzibu londa Think Deeper.

English master: Never use an AI answer unchecked.
French: N’utilisez jamais une réponse d’IA sans la vérifier.
Swahili: Usitumie kamwe jibu la AI bila kulikagua.
Luganda: Tokozesanga ekyokuddamu kya AI nga tonnakikebera.

English master: Five simple rules protect people and Ripple Effect.
French: Cinq règles simples protègent les personnes et Ripple Effect.
Swahili: Kanuni tano rahisi hulinda watu na Ripple Effect.
Amharic: አምስት ቀላል ደንቦች ሰዎችን እና Ripple Effectን ይጠብቃሉ።
Luganda: Amateeka ataano amangu gakuuma abantu ne Ripple Effect.
